Talking Head Video AI — Initial Release

- Launches skill to convert raw video recordings into polished, AI-enhanced talking head presenter videos.
- Supports MP4, MOV, WebM, AVI files up to 500MB, outputting 1080p MP4s in 1–2 minutes.
- Includes automatic API connection, free anonymous authentication, and session management.
- Provides features for video upload, editing (filler removal, lip sync), state tracking, credits inquiry, and streamlined export.
- Offers robust error handling, workflow tips, and user guidance for optimal results.
